summary: Big Sky Industrial Inc. (formerly U.S. Energy Corp.) filed an 8-K reporting a board-approved name change to Big Sky Industrial Inc. and a Nasdaq ticker change to 'BSIN', effective June 8, 2026. The amendment to the certificate of incorporation was filed under Delaware law and did not require stockholder approval. No material terms, prices, or transactions are involved; this is a routine corporate rebranding. The filing includes items 5.03, 7.01, 8.01, and 9.01, but does not relate to any special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. This is a straightforward name change with no economic event to analyze.
